svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 05 · Los Angeles · 03/12 Janss Steps (Rare)
svg.desc: The long brick stairway up to the old heart of campus. Count them once, then never again. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
